assessments.reasoning: RsyncProject/rsync COPYING at 02cfb7621cfea47b49aa30886ab0e4e3e03e78f8 returned the claimed digest across three contiguous parts covering 35,566 bytes. The opening grant explicitly names rsync, OpenSSL and xxhash.
The index admits documented additional permissions and excludes blanket compatibility verdicts. Its editorial mapping fits this project-specific grant.

challenge.method: Tested static linkage, distribution without library-license compliance, and a universal System Libraries classification against the complete opening paragraph and GPL §1.
challenge.results: The paragraph specifies dynamic linkage twice and expressly conditions library distribution. GPL §1 defines System Libraries by characteristics of the executable’s environment. The project’s observation cannot settle every application of that definition.

limitations: The grant is scoped to dynamic linkage in the pinned representation. The final sentence records the project’s view of GPL System Libraries coverage.
reasoning: Under “REGARDING OPENSSL AND XXHASH”, the copyright holders expressly permit dynamically linking rsync with the named libraries when those libraries are distributed in compliance with their terms, and distributing that dynamically linked combination. This is sufficient for the index’s editorial exception identity.
